name: Suspicious File Download From IP Via Wget.EXE
description: Detects potentially suspicious file downloads directly from IP addresses using Wget.exe
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\wget.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wget.exe) AND process.command_line:/:\/\/[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}/ AND process.command_line:*http* AND (process.command_line:/\s-O\s/ OR process.command_line:*\-\-output\-document*) AND (process.command_line:(*.ps1 OR *.ps1' OR *.ps1\" OR *.dat OR *.dat' OR *.dat\" OR *.msi OR *.msi' OR *.msi\" OR *.bat OR *.bat' OR *.bat\" OR *.exe OR *.exe' OR *.exe\" OR *.vbs OR *.vbs' OR *.vbs\" OR *.vbe OR *.vbe' OR *.vbe\" OR *.hta OR *.hta' OR *.hta\" OR *.dll OR *.dll' OR *.dll\" OR *.psm1 OR *.psm1' OR *.psm1\"))
